title: Aurelian Tensor Rig

classification.guidance: Preserve the concept as Lexi.PHYS worldbuilding and convert it into software artifacts: material cards, stress-field visualizations, repair-state simulations, and pitch visuals. Do not present it as literal vacuum engineering or completed quantum hardware.

concept: **The Physics of the Aurelian Tensor Rig** This isn't merely jewelry; it is a masterclass in **Tensegrity** and **Electromagnetic Levitation**. The structure relies on a balanced network of "floating" compression members held in place by continuous tension. By integrating micro-scale induction coils into the carbon-fiber lattice, the rig generates a localized magnetic field that interacts with the wearer's bio-electric signature. This creates a "geometric lock," allowing the piece to maintain its orientation regardless of the wearer's movement. In simpler terms: I’ve used the Lorentz force to ensure your silhouette never suffers the indignity of a sag.

blocked_claims: literal structure draped into the vacuum
literal wearable levitation or unsupported floating jewelry structure
using a wearer's bio-electric signature as a real control or authentication field
guaranteed silhouette/orientation control through Lorentz-force claims
powered wearable induction hardware without electrical and thermal safety review
prototype_conversion.first_safe_demo: Create a wearable tensegrity simulator where nodes, tension members, compression members, simulated coil strength, and orientation error are tracked without energizing real coils or interacting with the wearer.
